question: Will the US national debt (Treasury’s Debt to the Penny) be above $40.60 trillion on Thu 12 Nov 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": The US Treasury’s Debt to the Penny "Total Public Debt Outstanding" for record date 2026-11-12 is strictly above $40.60 trillion.
- "No": It is $40.60 trillion or lower.

Clarifications:
- Treasury publishes a record for each business day. If 2026-11-12 has none because of a federal holiday, use the latest record before it.
